|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[One Beautiful Thing]]; it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip, which prints it (so does the Players Committee card image, [[:File:VB6-D-onebeautifulthing-pre.gif]]).
* '''Original''' ([[One Beautiful Thing]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “Lose 1 Force to ▲ (or retrieve) Black Leader. OR During battle where you have no Dark Jedi or droids and only two cards with ability there (a male and a female), add one destiny to total power (and attrition against you = 0).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-47-One_Beautiful_Thing.png]]) prints it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[One Beautiful Thing (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed “take Black Leader into hand from Reserve Deck (or retrieve)” (the ▲ written out, “(or retrieve)” moved) and “two participating cards with ability” instead of “two cards with ability there”<ref name="cl-1261_46-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Lose 1 Force to take Black Leader into hand from Reserve Deck (or retrieve); reshuffle. OR During battle where you have no Dark Jedi or droids and only two participating cards with ability (a male and a female), add one destiny to total power (and attrition against you = 0).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-47-One_Beautiful_Thing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) names Juno Eclipse instead of Black Leader and restores the printed wording (“▲ (or retrieve)”, “two cards with ability there”)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38, page 38. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Lose 1 Force to ▲ (or retrieve) Juno Eclipse. OR During battle where you have no Dark Jedi or droids and only two cards with ability there (a male and a female), add one destiny to total power (and attrition against you = 0).” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-46-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-onebeautifulthing-pre.gif]]) print it.
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[One Beautiful Thing]]. For the earlier errata text, see [[One Beautiful Thing (Errata)]].
